title: Sherman County Historical Museum

services.name: Exhibits/Buildings
services.desc: The Hawk School was built in 1874 and originally located two miles south of Loup City. The lumber was hauled from Kearney by John L. Hawk; the first teacher was Clara Hawk. The building includes an original country school classroom complete with period student and teacher desks. This building was acquired by the SCHS in 1987.
